inference.direction_consistent_non_significant_mea: descriptive evidence only; report the directional case count, eligible case count, case median, unadjusted p, and Holm-adjusted p
inference.null_metric_meaning: not estimable; no eligible paired cases
inference.tied_calls_meaning: no observed tool-call reduction in the cohort

confirmatory_families.estimand: raw - split_pillars within the same model and case
semantic_graph - raw within the same model and case

inference.directional_non_significant_reporting: descriptive evidence only; report the directional case count, eligible case count, case median, unadjusted p, and Holm-adjusted p
inference.non_significant_meaning: insufficient evidence; not evidence of equivalence
inference.null_metric_meaning: not estimable; no eligible paired cases
inference.repetitions: descriptive; paired run deltas are reduced to a case median
inference.zero_call_delta_meaning: no observed tool-call reduction in the cohort

  AND s.timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-02 10:20:10' AND s.timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-02 11:30:10'
